agent.name: Asker & Analyst
agent.role: On each shift the Asker asks AI assistants the questions your buyers ask. The Analyst reads every answer, checks each quote word for word and counts which shops are recommended. The Master checks each hand-off.
agent.role_id: Setiap shift Asker menanyakan ke asisten AI pertanyaan yang biasa diajukan pembeli Anda. Analyst membaca setiap jawaban, mengecek setiap kutipan kata per kata, dan menghitung toko mana yang direkomendasikan. Master mengecek setiap serah-terima.

team.name: Auditor
team.title: Site auditor
team.job: Will check the store's own website for what AI assistants can and cannot read.
team.job_id: Akan mengecek website toko: apa yang bisa dan tidak bisa dibaca asisten AI.

team.name: Asker
team.title: Asks the AI assistants
team.job: Keeps the same core questions for the trend and writes new ones aimed at the topics where the store is named least, learning from what was asked before. Checks them and asks each one to Gemini. Every answer is stored, empty ones too.
team.job_id: Memakai pertanyaan inti yang sama untuk tren, dan menulis pertanyaan baru yang diarahkan ke topik di mana toko paling jarang disebut, belajar dari pertanyaan sebelumnya. Mengeceknya lalu menanyakan masing-masing ke Gemini. Setiap jawaban disimpan, termasuk yang kosong.

team.name: Analyst
team.title: Reads and counts
team.job: Reads every answer, checks each quote word for word, counts the store against its competitors, compares with the last shift and writes the owner summary.
team.job_id: Membaca setiap jawaban, mengecek setiap kutipan kata per kata, menghitung toko dibanding kompetitor, membandingkan dengan shift lalu, dan menulis ringkasan untuk pemilik.

team.name: Planner
team.title: Planner
team.job: Will turn the gaps into a short list of tasks, each with its evidence.
team.job_id: Akan mengubah celah yang ditemukan menjadi daftar tugas singkat, masing-masing dengan buktinya.

team.name: Owner
team.title: Approves the changes
team.job: The store owner reviews the tasks and evidence. Nothing changes on the site without approval.
team.job_id: Pemilik toko meninjau tugas dan buktinya. Tidak ada yang berubah di website tanpa persetujuan.

team.name: Fixer
team.title: Fixer
team.job: Will prepare and publish the approved changes, with a backup to restore.
team.job_id: Akan menyiapkan dan menerbitkan perubahan yang disetujui, dengan backup untuk dipulihkan.

team.name: Reporter
team.title: Reporter
team.job: Will compare before and after, add AI visits from analytics, and report to the owner, zeros included.
team.job_id: Akan membandingkan sebelum dan sesudah, menambahkan kunjungan dari AI lewat analytics, dan melapor ke pemilik, termasuk hasil nol.

team.name: Master
team.title: Checks every hand-off
team.job: Checks each agent's output before the next one uses it. Today: the Asker's answers are complete, and the Analyst's numbers match the answers.
team.job_id: Mengecek hasil setiap agent sebelum dipakai agent berikutnya. Saat ini: jawaban dari Asker lengkap, dan angka Analyst cocok dengan jawabannya.
